title: Recover P via the revised GT STNFS core with direct chunk scatter routing: 121.8542

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm in proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q and uniform z (P = infinity exactly for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 (modelled lower bound 0.391949 - 2^-48), conditional on the disclosed H1-H5 of source-core.md. It computes the base g=e(P0,Q), which is exactly uniform on GT minus {1} and independent of z, converts g and z into the STNFS tower by the explicit charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. The core is the recover-Q core of submission e3940d11 with the main-phase revision of REVISION.md (from submission 27202622): 99.9% per-prime main-phase ECM (403 curves per side), relation sub-region theta=207/500, cofactor slacks (300, 228), descent missing-log inputs 747.5/498.9 with the unchanged plan, two-log meter 2^118.635, plus this package's direct chunk scatter of relation-collection records at emission (the STORAGE.md listing, 21 instead of 36 instructions per record) and canonical-work allowance 1.0593 (>= 1 + 2.00 incidence-inclusive SE); its upper-rounded complete ledger is below 2^121.8398 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000) with success at least 0.391949. Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, both pairings, verification and output, is at most (101/100) x 2^121.8398 + 2^80/20000 < 2^121.8542 dense-Fp12 units; the 101/100 is a reserve on the whole core instruction ledger. Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes every quantity changed by REVISION.md from the shipped code and data: theta=207/500 region, certified count products, yield and margin, incidence-inclusive work SE and allowance, 99.9% ECM schedules, linear algebra, the complete descent recurrence at the new inputs, node-counter and repeat terms, success and the full ledger; the STORAGE.md listing hot-path count and scatter/radix equivalence; then checks the recover-P total and success. Does not rerun unchanged inherited certificates.

Optional full recomputation of all inherited certificates (resultant, tower, rho, pool regeneration, filtering, retention, ECM toys, fields, alpha, audit) together with the revised model and declared bounds.
